declare

Begin
 /* -- new tz function
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356

 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else

 end if;

 temp_buffer := :s_contract_id;
 
 select company 
 into :s_company 
 from contracts
 where contract_id = temp_buffer
 and contract_type = 'RG'
 --and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */ --RP06012018 MLT#257
 and LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(temp_buffer, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_time + 10); -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356

exception

 begin
 select contract_id, company 
 into :s_contract_id, :s_company
 from contracts
 where company = temp_buffer
 and contract_type = 'RG'
 --and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */ --RP06012018 MLT#257
 and LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_time + 10); -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select contract_id, company 
 into :s_contract_id, :s_company
 from contracts
 where upper(company) like ('%' || temp_buffer || '%')
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_time + 10) -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 --and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */ --RP06012018 MLT#257
 and LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
 and contract_type = 'RG';

 :s_contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_company := null;

 when no_data_found then
 --show_error('5150');
 show_error('1147');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then 
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when too_many_rows then
 :s_contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_company := null;
 list_values;
 when others then 
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when others then 
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
end;

declare

begin

 begin

 from batch_inputs b
 where b.batch_id = :batch_id and
 substr(b.batch_id,8,2) = 'RG' and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and

 from units
 where batch_id = b.batch_id
 and contract_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and qc_checkin_date is null);

 where batch_id = :batch_id and

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor c1 is 
 select coll_date
 from units
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
 and batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id;
 
 t_rec_found number;
 t_date_match varchar2(1) := 'Y';
begin
 :Global.Error_count := 'N'; -- This is used in the on-error triger
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure; 
 if nvl(:global.error_count, 'N') != 'Y' then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into t_rec_found
 from units
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
 and batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date);
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if t_rec_found > 0 then 
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 if trunc(c1rec.coll_date) != trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) then
 t_date_match := 'N';
 end if;
 end loop;
 if t_date_match = 'N' then
 show_error('0500');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 go_block('units');
 execute_query(FOR_UPDATE,NO_WAIT);
 end if;
 else
 show_error('1145');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; -- t_rec_found
 end if; -- global.error_count
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

select b.batch_id, to_char(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, received_date),'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') 
from batch_inputs b 
where b.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
and contract_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id 
and batch_id in (select batch_id 
 from units 
 where contract_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id 
 and chapter_id =:s_chapter_id 
 and qc_checkin_date is null) 
and substr(batch_id,8,2)='RG'

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_S_CONTRACT__LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT contracts.contract_id, company
FROM contracts, batch_inputs b
WHERE ( contracts.contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id
OR upper(company) LIKE ('%'
 ||:ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id
 || '%'))
AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE)

AND contract_type ='RG'
AND LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contracts.contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
AND
 b.contract_id = contracts.contract_id
AND (qc_date IS NULL
OR batch_id IN
 (SELECT batch_id
 FROM units
 WHERE contract_id =contracts.contract_id
 AND chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 AND qc_checkin_date IS NULL
 ))
AND SUBSTR(batch_id,8,2)='RG'
ORDER BY company

Trigger.Name: DO_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 v_local_time date;
Begin
 if :perform_commit = 'Y'
 then
 go_block('units');
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :qc_checkin_flag in ('Y')
 then
 if :red_tube_flag is null or :red_tube_2_flag is null or 
 :purple_tube_flag is null or
 :serum_plasma_ind is null
 then
/*
 show_error('0225');
 check_package_failure;
*/
 :qc_checkin_flag:=null;
 else
 :qc_checkin_date := sysdate; 
 end if;
/*
 else
 if :qc_checkin_flag is not null
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :units.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_received_date := :units.received_date;
 show_error('0225');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
*/
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 update batch_inputs
 set qc_date = sysdate
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 contract_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id ;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error('0000');
 --show_error('8010');
 --check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 else
 go_block('units');
 end if;
end;
